edition.notes: Nineteenth-century Latin edition described by its editor as controlled against four manuscripts and the first edition. It is used as an exact printed historical control, not as a modern critical edition.
edition.publication: Cologne, Bonn, and Brussels: J. M. Heberle / H. Lempertz
edition.title: Caesarii Heisterbacensis Dialogus miraculorum, volume 2

passages.context: Distinctio VII, chapter 24, printed pp. 52-53, directly inspected. The account narrates reception at a monastery, prior unsuccessful efforts, a hosteller's devotional acts and adjuration, reported recovery, and an identified informant chain.
passages.notes: Evidence for the narrative's construction and selected devotional repertoire, not a ritual formulary, authorization record, neutral case file, prevalence survey, diagnosis, or proof of efficacy.
passages.reason: The exact bytes are not retained in this repository; the record keeps their retrieval location, hash and rights instead.
passages.rights_basis: The medieval text and 1851 edition are public domain by age.

work.author: Caesarius of Heisterbach
work.description: A thirteenth-century didactic dialogue arranged in distinctions and chapters. Its narrated exempla are constructed testimony within a moral and devotional work, not neutral case files.
work.title: Dialogus miraculorum
